notes: Independent critic-only inspection; no production art, composer, layout, existing proof or final render was edited. Read BRIEF-17, both panel briefs, NOTES methods, cycle-6 FIXES and the preceding critic findings. Reviewed all 110 manifest sprites at exact native size and nearest-neighbour 4x in critic contact sheets, the city at native size and sixteen exact 4x tiles, and selected joins at 8x. Reviewed the ten ground tiles in literal 3x3 repeats, and C6 props against summer grass, cobbles and packed yard; large architecture has separate full-sprite inspection. No C6 seasonal partners are present, so seasonal-ground/summer-silhouette testing is not applicable. All 32 slate/brown material partners retain their source alpha masks exactly. Independent technical checks: all 110 manifest dimensions and hashes match; all have alpha only 0/255 and zero RGB under transparency. All 15 scoped 48px facade modules checked retain the shared rows 0/47. Eight representative registered drawings replayed to their saved 64-sample mode results exactly; this is a sampled process check, not a claim to have replayed every source. The fresh full composition equals the saved native final; 2x, greyscale, all three 3x crops and the comparison source panels are exact derivatives. Native district is 1920x1440, 40x30 cells, following the coordinator override. Storey histogram independently recounted: 57 modular buildings {1:2,2:32,3:18,4:4,5:1}; including the nine ancillary ordinary buildings, 66 total {1:10,2:33,3:18,4:4,5:1}, with 15.15% one-storey. Modular roof colours: 29 terracotta,18 slate,10 brown. All 42 resolved five-house frontage windows pass an independent pixel-identity occurrence count; the composer also reports 208 passing module windows. Legacy L-block, market and height-test repetition checks pass (28,21,16 windows respectively); the Part E repeat issue is resolved. Visible repairs accepted: actual northwest T/jog, east stepped/wedge block, southern full-cell stagger, L blocks, 24px passages, continuous 96px gate-road turn, inn on that road, uneven towers and joined frontages. Enclosed property strips and trade yards now read as properties; no frontage lawn remains. Mixed roofs and mixed heights are retained. The broad guildhall, supported church east porch, inward-facing market hall, usable shop landings, northwest court reveal, compatible curtain courses, restrained structural shade, distinct house/tower silhouettes, bracketed signs, six-stall working aisle, supported gate, service stores/drain, shrine apron, forge smoke, vendors and unloading cart visibly address FIXES 1-3,5-9,11-19. The nine standalone assets failed by critic round2 are now acceptable individually. The remaining failure is assembled contact handling under FIXES 4 and 10, and consequently acceptance item20. Gate normal/reveal and front-actor proofs and church/court entrance reveals were inspected at native and 4x; these are draw-order demonstrations, not runtime collision validation. BRIEF-17 prevails over waived footprint, sign-size, gate-height and cross-lot-shadow suggestions as recorded in FIXES. Passing the new standalone drawings and route/count tests does not waive visible roof holes.
